newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products recover, fuel firms $2 late.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products recover, fuel firms $2 late.

text.p: NWE oil products recovered from early weakness with fuel finishing strong, particularly on low sulphur. Naphtha held steady in balanced trade with few cargoes on offer and buyers generally relaxed.
Spot gasoline prices recovered some of their early losses to end steady with firmer NYMEX unleaded improving sentiment.
Gas oil was firmer as benchmark futures made fresh five year highs, although reluctant buying dampened physical trade.
Fuel oil prices were firm towards the close but most activity was on swaps which implied levels of near $114 fob for high sulphur barges. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7456
